raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Construction may be delayed if the transmission line is not completed before the winter construction season.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Advance procurement and civil works planning; start activities early to align with the short construction season and include winter contingency.",
      "evidence": "If it cannot be completed before winter, the Project will have more delays with waiting for the next construction season."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Insufficient local capacity to manufacture 220 kV poles and conductors could cause procurement bottlenecks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early market engagement, pre‑qualify suppliers, and arrange imports of certified components with strict quality‑assurance clauses.",
      "evidence": "no local company who can produce metal poles and conductors meeting the standards for 220kV lines."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "New Project Management Office (PMO) staff lack experience in World Bank financial management procedures.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit a qualified financial officer before loan signing and provide intensive FM training with ongoing Bank support.",
      "evidence": "PMO is not yet in place and no financial management staff has been appointed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Weak budgeting and cost controls may lead to funds being used for unintended purposes.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust budgeting, quarterly variance analysis, and require PSC approval of any major re‑allocations.",
      "evidence": "Poor budgeting: The project funds not used for the intended purposes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Bird collisions and biodiversity impacts could arise from the new overhead transmission line.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Bird Management Plan, install flight diverters, and monitor avifauna along the corridor.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines often involve bird collision and other biodiversity issues; a Bird Management Plan was prepared."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Construction activities may cause soil erosion, noise, and disturbance to local wildlife and communities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply erosion control measures, dust suppression, noise limits, and conduct community notification prior to works.",
      "evidence": "Construction ... heavy equipment and construction noise and disturbance on bird sensitive areas, soil erosion during minor civil work."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Temporary restriction of pasture and water access could affect local herders and raise social tensions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a community liaison plan, provide compensation or alternative access, and schedule works to minimize disruption.",
      "evidence": "Community safety during the construction phase, with temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Grievances may not be resolved promptly, eroding community trust.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Publicize the GRM widely, train staff on response timelines, and monitor grievance logs for timely closure.",
      "evidence": "The project level grievance redress mechanism (GRM) will replicate the mechanisms ... two‑stage approach."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Changes in government officials after elections could disrupt project continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage promptly with incoming officials, secure written commitments, and embed continuity clauses in MoE agreements.",
      "evidence": "Potential changes in Government officials involved in project activities due to election cycle."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Perceived corruption and high‑level interference in procurement may cause delays and reputational risk.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt transparent procurement with independent evaluation, anti‑corruption safeguards, and regular monitoring by the Bank.",
      "evidence": "High level of corruption perception. Interference of the high‑level officials in procurement decision making."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Design may not withstand extreme climate events, leading to premature failures.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply enhanced engineering standards for wind, snow, temperature, earthquake and flood as defined in the EHSG.",
      "evidence": "Enhanced engineering and design standards that consider weather and natural hazards ... wind loading, earthquake and flood."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Heavy reliance on imported construction materials makes the project vulnerable to border closures or pandemic disruptions.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Identify alternative local suppliers, maintain buffer inventories, and monitor global logistics to adjust schedules as needed.",
      "evidence": "75‑80% of construction materials are sourced from outside the country; pandemic or border closures could have significant impact."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Occupational health and safety risks from live lines, work at height, and EMF exposure.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict OHS protocols, worker training, EMF monitoring, signage, and emergency procedures.",
      "evidence": "OHS risks associated with live power lines, working at height, electric and magnetic fields (EMF)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Delay or shortfall in counterpart funding could stall component‑2 capacity‑building activities.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish an escrow account for counterpart funds, require quarterly reporting, and enforce contractual penalties for delays.",
      "evidence": "Borrower shall provide ... counterpart funds ... in a timely manner, minimum amount $840,000."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Local contractors lack sufficient human resources and technical capacity, risking procurement delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct market sounding, provide targeted capacity‑building, and consider joint ventures with experienced foreign firms.",
      "evidence": "Many local companies lack human resources; no local company can produce metal poles and conductors meeting standards."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Insufficient ongoing capacity building may limit sustainability of project outcomes.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a continuous training program, periodic competency assessments, and refresher courses for PMO staff.",
      "evidence": "Capacity building activities ... moderate social risk; ongoing stakeholder engagement required for sustainability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Private investors may not develop the expected volume of VRE projects, reducing financial returns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Offer de‑risking instruments, guarantee grid access, and align tariff reforms to improve project bankability.",
      "evidence": "Only 100 MW expected private development; monetary estimate US$110 million captured in results framework."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Audit findings may not be addressed, weakening financial controls and increasing misuse risk.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a formal audit‑follow‑up action plan, assign responsibility, and monitor implementation with Bank oversight.",
      "evidence": "Poor follow‑up on audit findings: PMO does not address audit findings noted by the auditors."
    }
  ]
}
